Disclaimers

To keep Wash 66 running safely and smoothly, the following policies are in effect. If anything is unclear, ask the attendant at the entrance before you go through.

On this page

Safety Limitations Detailing Vacuums Packages Pricing Customer conduct

Safety

Follow all posted instructions and the directions of Wash 66 staff.

Do not drive your vehicle through the car wash tunnel.

Drivers will be fully responsible for any damage and injury that may occur when violating this policy. We reserve the right to perform any inspection or repair services at our accredited facility.

Do not apply your brakes at any point during the washing process.

It causes us to be out of service due to the chain coming off the track. Violation of this policy can result in revocation of membership.

Limitations

The soft-touch express exterior car wash is designed to clean everyday road grime of the sort a car might reasonably accumulate during typical use. We cannot service excessively soiled vehicles, such as:

  • Vehicles used for "mudding" or off-roading
  • Trucks with debris in the truck bed
  • Vehicles that have had harsh chemicals spilled over or inside them

Attempts to clean excessively soiled vehicles can damage our equipment and ruin the wash experience for the next customers.

Height clearance: the clearance at the tunnel entrance is 7'2" (2.18 m). If your vehicle, roof rack, cargo box or anything mounted on top doesn't clear it, please don't enter the tunnel. Ask an attendant if you're not sure.

We may be unable to wash vehicles with certain accessories or body damage. Wash 66 is not responsible for damage to:

  • Antennas
  • Antenna moldings
  • Sun visors
  • Bug shields
  • Windshield wipers
  • Mirrors
  • Luggage racks
  • Extended tire valve stems
  • Loose vehicle body parts
  • Existing body or parts damage
  • Non-factory installed items
  • Articles in pickup beds

If your vehicle has parts that are loose, rusted, rotted, cracked or previously damaged, we recommend having them repaired before using our wash.

The exterior soft-touch wash is designed for standard size passenger vehicles. Oversize vehicles may not fit through the tunnel, and we are unable to wash vehicles that exceed our equipment size limits.

Detailing

Vehicle detailing packages provide light vehicle cleaning and maintenance. For the safety of our staff, we reserve the right to refuse excessively soiled vehicles. "Excessively soiled" includes, but is not limited to:

  • Excessive garbage
  • Blood
  • Broken glass
  • Mold
  • Vermin infestation
  • Sharp objects

Please remove personal items from the vehicle or secure them in the glove compartment before detailing. Wash 66 is not responsible for personal items left in the vehicle during detailing, and items left in the vehicle may be treated as garbage and cleaned out.

Please remove all garbage from the cabin and trunk before your detail. If garbage remains, a removal fee of $20 to $40 applies, depending on the amount and the time it takes.

Detailing depends on staff availability, so we recommend booking ahead to make sure we can fit in the services you want.

Vacuums

Use of our vehicle interior vacuums is included with the purchase of a car wash. If you hold a monthly membership, you may vacuum your vehicle once per day, whether you use the wash that day or not. Without a wash or membership, vacuum use is $5.

Vacuums are for cleaning vehicle cabin interiors only, and are for Wash 66 customers only. Please don't detail your vehicle in the vacuum bay, and if there is a line for the vacuums, be considerate of others waiting their turn.

Packages

  • Monthly packages are valid for one month, measured from the date of purchase.
  • Packages renew automatically unless the membership is cancelled. Cancellations require at least 20 days' notice before your billing date.
  • All changes to membership accounts must be made on site, not by phone or email.
  • A package holder may wash their vehicle a maximum of once per day.
  • Packages are issued per vehicle, not per person or per household. If you own two vehicles, you need two packages, or a package for the vehicle you drive most and single washes for the other.
  • RFID tags must be placed on vehicle windshields by a Wash 66 attendant. Anyone driving a tagged vehicle may wash it; the driver does not have to be the person who bought the package.
  • Monthly memberships are billed automatically to a credit card. We accept all major credit cards, and cash for single washes, prepay deals, detailing and gift cards.
  • Fleet rates are available. Contact us for details.

Pricing

Single wash prices include HST. Monthly memberships, prepaid membership deals and detailing are plus HST.

Customer conduct

To keep the wash pleasant for everyone, we prohibit loud music and boisterous or aggressive behaviour on Wash 66 property. Please place all trash in the garbage cans. 24 hour video surveillance is in use on our premises.

Questions about any of this? Call 506-847-7627 or email info@wash66.com. Last updated October 2026.
